scope: Exact arithmetic from E06 single JPEG samples; not p95, sustained throughput, compressed derivative sizes or a grant
exclusions: Public derivatives, video renditions, keograms/maps, sidecars/revisions
Render scratch, compact promotion overlap, quarantine, orphan/multipart residue
Database base/WAL/history, manifest/metadata overhead, actual storage replication
Offsite versions, protection/hide retention and catch-up overhead
limitations: Each camera has one successful sample, not a distribution
Do not use these figures as an upper bound or owner reservation
Real admission uses measured per-camera p95 and peak backlog/scratch plus all additional classes
